<thought>I need to determine how many aromatic carbons are present in the unknown molecule. The most direct way is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum and count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (≈120–150 ppm). This requires a single carbon NMR measurement, which is acceptable given the task.</thought>
